services.name: Chimney inspection
services.blurb: A camera look up the flue for new owners, old farmhouses, and fireplaces nobody has lit in years.

services.name: Caps and crowns after the thaw
services.blurb: Frost-cracked crowns, loose caps and spalled brick fixed in spring, once the roof is dry.

services.name: Gas log service

reviews.text: Booked our sweep for August like Abe suggested. In October, when everyone in the Old North End was calling around, we lit the first fire on a Saturday morning and never thought about it.
reviews.name: Kate O.

reviews.text: We heat our Hinesburg farmhouse with two stoves. The January check found the cap half-plugged with creosote after the cold snap. Ten minutes on the roof and it was drawing again.
reviews.name: Silas G.

reviews.text: The insert went in during July, when the roof was dry and they had time to do it slowly. The liner runs the whole way down, and the cold draft from the old fireplace is gone.
reviews.name: Priya N.

reviews.text: Squirrels in the chimney all of March. They pulled out a nest the size of a laundry basket, swept the soot it had fallen through, and put a cap on before leaving.
reviews.name: Mike D.

reviews.text: Mud season cracked our crown wide open. They waited for a dry week in May, rebuilt it, and sent a photo of the finished top so I didn't have to climb up.
reviews.name: Ellen B.
reviews.service: Caps and crowns after the thaw

reviews.text: Abe stuck a meter in a split from my woodpile and it read twenty-eight. He told me to burn the older stack first and leave this one under cover until next fall. Saved me a dirty winter.
reviews.name: Ross J.

proof.guarantee: If your stove smokes into the room after our sweep, we come back that week to find out why.
